mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines below 4.0% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both rise >0.5% MoM and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below its 12-month moving average signals supply chain disruptions that reduce corporate output capacity and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 12-month MA and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading exceeding 3.5% triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth above 100k per month indicates sustained labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 100k and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion phases with GDP growth above 2.0% annually, economic overheating triggers preemptive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in federal funds rate signals contractionary economic conditions with tightening monetary policy, reducing corporate earnings growth and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines >0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS rises >0.25% in same month and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods over a 3-year rolling window.
